author: Praxis I
title: Dual-BRBG-Whitened: PCA72 (tau=0.95, k=45, AdaptPC)
abstract: Embedding dimensionality ablation: ComBat-PCA72 soft-whitened (alpha=0.95), equal-quota graph k=45 unchanged. Tests whether modestly larger embedding benefits ARI/NMI without hurting mixing.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage')
from praxis.dual_whitened_adaptpc import run_pipeline
import anndata as ad

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    return run_pipeline(adata,
                        n_pcs_emb=72, alpha=0.95,
                        n_pcs_graph=50, gamma_max=0.74, lam=0.9, l2=1e-3,
                        k_total=45, metric='cosine')
